title: Errors messages are not flushed to the debugger window, and can be lost if the application quits immediately
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.5 stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (RADV NAVI21) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900K CPU @ 3.70GHz (20 threads) - 62.63 GiB memory

### Issue description

Errors printed with `printerr` are not flushed to the debugger window, and if the application exits soon after, there is a good likelihood that they are lost.

They are technically not flushed on the StdLogger either:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef34c3d534a16b140aef0643ed2fa36f8e9d1612/core/io/logger.cpp#L221C1-L221C73 but on Linux at least stderr is unbuffered by default, so I can see them printed out even if they do not appear on the debugging panel.

As errors have important diagnostic information, they should always be flushed AND immediately visible on the debugging panel even if the application terminates immediately.

### Steps to reproduce

```
printerr("Error initialising application")
get_tree().quit(1)
```

On my system, the error is shown ~10% of the time.

N/A
